blocks.text: The Guru’s words exposed the false claim of imperial righteousness: if the emperor truly wished to prove his case, let him first confront the Guru openly. (38)
The Guru rejected the shallow compromise associated with Ram Rai and refused to save himself by surrendering truth. (39–40)
Instead he declared that real religion is tested in steadfastness, not in outward display.
